后降的趋势［2］ 。 2006 年，Connert 等［5］首次应用 HIP-55卢应梅( 1972 － ) ，女，博士，教授，博士生导师，研究方向:
Interaction between gut microbiota and drugs
ZHANG Ya-ting 1，2 ，SUN Yue-mei 2 ，ZHANG Juan-hong 2 ，HUO Yan1，2 ，LI Xue 1，2 ，LI Wen-bin2 ，ZHAO An-peng 2 ，WANG Rong 1，2( 1． School of Pharmacy，Lanzhou University，Lanzhou 730000，China; 2． Key Lab of the Plateau Medicine， the 940th Hospital of Joint Logistics Support Force，PLA，Lanzhou 730050，China)Abstract: A variety of microbial communities have colonized in human skin，mouth，nasopharynx，intestinal tract and other parts，constituting dynamic microecosystem together with their habitat environment，in which gut microbiota communities are overwhelming in number and variety，in consort with the intestinal environment，forming the most important microecosystem in human body． The symbiotic relationship between gut microbiota and human body greatly influences the host digestion and absorption， homeostasis maintenance，physiological and pathological status， drug metabolism and so on． There are complex interactions between gut microbiota and drugs，the number of species of gut microbiota will be affected after drugs enter the body． Gut microbiota exert activate，inactivate or toxicity metabolism effect on traditional Chinese medicine and chemical medicine． Based on literature review，this paper summarizes the interaction between gut microbiota and drugs，and the mechanism of the influence of gut microbiota on drug metabolism．
